correctness.rationale: For \(n\geq0\), the quotient is a positive integer with valuation floor(n/(p-1))-v_p((n+1)!). The exact 2-adic formula restricts n+1 to one or two binary ones; the exact 3-adic formula imposes parity-dependent ternary bounds. The 24-low-ternary-digit filter is a one-way valid exclusion, followed by exact ternary evaluation for all retained parameters with exponents at most 16384. This yields 42 candidates; full prime divisibility through 65664 excludes seven by square divisors and certifies the 35 displayed indices. Direct small product and small brute-force cross-checks passed. No reasoning extrapolates past the bound.
